current_text: Out of the ground YHWH Elohim made every tree to grow that is pleasant to the sight, and good for food, including the tree of life in the middle of the garden and the tree of the knowledge of good and evil.
but you shall not eat of the tree of the knowledge of good and evil; for in the day that you eat of it, you will surely die.”
for Elohim knows that in the day you eat it, your eyes will be opened, and you will be like Elohim, knowing good and evil.”
YHWH Elohim said, “Look, the man has become like one of us, knowing good and evil. Now, lest the man reach out a hand, and also take of the tree of life, and eat, and live forever—”
YHWH saw that human wickedness was great in the earth, and that every imagination of the thoughts of the human heart was continually only evil.

YHWH smelled the pleasant aroma. YHWH said in YHWH’s heart, “I will not again curse the ground any more for humanity’s sake because the imagination of the human heart inclines toward evil from youth. I will never again strike every living thing, as I have done.
When they had gone out of the city, and were not yet far off, Yosef said to his steward, “Up, follow after the men. When you overtake them, ask them, ‘Why have you rewarded evil for good?

The people were as murmurers, [speaking] evil in the ears of YHWH: and when YHWH heard it, YHWH’s anger was kindled; and the fire of YHWH burnt among them, and devoured in the uttermost part of the camp.

Moreover your little ones, whom you said should be a prey, and your children, who this day have no knowledge of good or evil, they shall go in there, and to them will I give it, and they shall possess it.

That prophet, or that dreamer of dreams, shall be put to death, because he has spoken rebellion against YHWH your God, who brought you out of the land of Mitzrayim, and redeemed you out of the house of bondage, to draw you aside out of the way which YHWH your God commanded you to walk in. So shall you put away the evil from the midst of you.
You shall not sacrifice to YHWH your God an ox, or a sheep, in which is a blemish, [or] anything evil; for that is an abomination to YHWH your God.
The hand of the witnesses shall be first on him to put him to death, and afterward the hand of all the people. So you shall put away the evil from the midst of you.

The one who does presumptuously, in not listening to the priest who stands to minister there before YHWH your God, or to the judge, even that man shall die: and you shall put away the evil from Israel.
then shall you do to him, as he had thought to do to his brother: so shall you put away the evil from the midst of you.
Those who remain shall hear, and fear, and shall henceforth commit no more any such evil in the midst of you.
All the men of his city shall stone him to death with stones: so shall you put away the evil from the midst of you; and all Israel shall hear, and fear.

then they shall bring out the young lady to the door of her father's house, and the men of her city shall stone her to death with stones, because she has done folly in Israel, to play the prostitute in her father's house: so shall you put away the evil from the midst of you.
If someone be found lying with a woman married to a husband, then they shall both of them die, the one who lay with the woman, and the woman: so shall you put away the evil from Israel.

then you shall bring them both out to the gate of that city, and you shall stone them to death with stones; the lady, because she didn't cry, being in the city; and the person, because they have humbled their neighbor's wife: so you shall put away the evil from the midst of you.

If someone be found stealing any of their brothers of the children of Israel, and they deal with them as a slave, or sell them; then that thief shall die: so shall you put away the evil from the midst of you.
Behold, I have set before you this day life and good, and death and evil;
I will surely hide my face in that day for all the evil which they shall have worked, in that they are turned to other gods.

Now therefore deliver up the men, the base fellows, who are in Gibeah, that we may put them to death, and put away evil from Israel. But Binyamin would not listen to the voice of their brothers the children of Israel.

Behold; if it goes up by the way of its own border to Beit Shemesh, then he has done us this great evil: but if not, then we shall know that it is not his hand that struck us; it was a chance that happened to us."
All the people said to Shmuel, Pray for your servants to YHWH your God, that we not die; for we have added to all our sins [this] evil, to ask us a king.
Shmuel said to the people, "Don't be afraid; you have indeed done all this evil; yet don't turn aside from following YHWH, but serve YHWH with all your heart:

Moreover, my father, behold, yes, see the skirt of your robe in my hand; for in that I cut off the skirt of your robe, and didn't kill you, know you and see that there is neither evil nor disobedience in my hand, and I have not sinned against you, though you hunt after my life to take it.
He said to Dawid, You are more righteous than I; for you have rendered to me good, whereas I have rendered to you evil.
Now Dawid had said, Surely in vain have I kept all that this fellow has in the wilderness, so that nothing was missed of all that pertained to him: and he has returned me evil for good.

Now therefore, my lord, as YHWH lives, and as your soul lives, seeing YHWH has withheld you from blood guiltiness, and from avenging yourself with your own hand, now therefore let your enemies, and those who seek evil to my lord, be as Nabal.

Why have you despised the word of YHWH, to do that which is evil in his sight? You have struck Uriyah the Hittite with the sword, and have taken his wife to be your wife, and have slain him with the sword of the children of Ammon.
Give your servant therefore an understanding heart to judge your people, that I may discern between good and evil; for who is able to judge this your great people?

Moreover by the prophet Yehu the son of Hanani came the word of YHWH against Baasha, and against his house, both because of all the evil that he did in the sight of YHWH, to provoke him to anger with the work of his hands, in being like the house of Yerovam, and because he struck him.

The king of Israel said to Yehoshafat, there is yet one man by whom we may inquire of YHWH, Micaiah the son of Imlah: but I hate him; for he does not prophesy good concerning me, but evil. Yehoshafat said, "Don't let the king say so."
The king of Israel said to Yehoshafat, Didn't I tell you that he would not prophesy good concerning me, but evil?

Hazael said, Why weeps my lord? He answered, Because I know the evil that you will do to the children of Israel: their strongholds will you set on fire, and their young people will you kill with the sword, and will dash in pieces their little ones, and rip up their women with child.
But they didn't listen: and Menashe seduced them to do that which is evil more than did the nations whom YHWH destroyed before the children of Israel.

It happened in the seven and thirtieth year of the captivity of Jehoiachin king of Yehudah, in the twelfth month, on the seven and twentieth day of the month, that Evilmerodach king of Bavel, in the year that he began to reign, did lift up the head of Jehoiachin king of Yehudah out of prison;

They shall answer, Because they abandoned YHWH, the God of their fathers, who brought them forth out of the land of Mitzrayim, and laid hold on other gods, and worshiped them, and served them: therefore has he brought all this evil on them.

The king of Israel said to Yehoshafat, There is yet one man by whom we may inquire of YHWH: but I hate him; for he never prophesies good concerning me, but always evil: the same is Micaiah the son of Imla. Yehoshafat said, Don't let the king say so.
The king of Israel said to Yehoshafat, Didn't I tell you that he would not prophesy good concerning me, but evil?
and I came to Yerushalayim, and understood the evil that Eliashib had done for Tobiah, in preparing him a chamber in the courts of the house of Elohim.
Shall we then listen to you to do all this great evil, to trespass against our God in marrying foreign women?
When I looked for good, then evil came; When I waited for light, there came darkness.
"If I have rejoiced at the destruction of the one who hated me, or lifted up myself when evil found him;
For you are not an Elohim who has pleasure in wickedness. evil can't live with you.
if I have rewarded evil to the one who was at peace with me (yes, if I have delivered the one who without cause was my adversary),
The one who doesn't slander with their tongue, nor does evil to their friend, nor casts slurs against their fellow man;
Even though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil, for you are with me. Your rod and your staff, they comfort me.
evil shall kill the wicked. Those who hate the righteous shall be condemned.
They reward me evil for good, to the bereaving of my soul.
They plot iniquity on their bed. They set themselves in a way that is not good. They don't abhor evil.
Cease from anger, and forsake wrath. Don't fret, it leads only to acting from evil.
They shall not be disappointed in the time of evil. In the days of famine they shall be satisfied.
They who also render evil for good are adversaries to me, because I follow what is good.
Blessed is the one who considers the poor. YHWH will deliver them in the day of evil.
Why should I fear in the days of evil, when iniquity at my heels surrounds me?
"You give your mouth to evil. Your tongue frames deceit.
Against you, and you only, have I sinned, and done that which is evil in your sight; that you may be proved right when you speak, and justified when you judge.
You love evil more than good, lying rather than speaking the truth. Selah.
YHWH will repay the evil to my enemies. Destroy them in your truth.
All day long they twist my words. All their thoughts are against me for evil.
They encourage themselves in evil plans. They talk about laying snares secretly. They say, "Who will see them?"
Lift up your feet to the perpetual ruins, all the evil that the enemy has done in the sanctuary.
Elohim threw on them the fierceness of Elohim’s anger, wrath, indignation, and trouble, and a band of angels of evil.
Make us glad for as many days as you have afflicted us, for as many years as we have seen evil.
no evil shall happen to you, neither shall any plague come near your dwelling.
You who love YHWH, hate evil. YHWH preserves the souls of YHWH’s saints. YHWH delivers them out of the hand of the wicked.
A perverse heart will be far from me. I will have nothing to do with evil.
YHWH, don't grant the desires of the wicked. Don't let their evil plans succeed, or they will become proud. Selah.
A malicious speaker won't be established in the earth. Evil will hunt the violent person to overthrow them.
for their feet run to evil. They hurry to shed blood.
to deliver you from the way of evil, from the people who speak perverse things;
who rejoice to do wrong, and delight in the perverseness of evil;
Reverence for YHWH is to hate evil. I hate pride, arrogance, the wrong way, and the perverse mouth.
The one who is truly righteous gets life. The one who pursues evil gets death.
The one who diligently seeks good seeks favor, but the one who searches after evil, it shall come to them.
No mischief shall happen to the righteous, but the wicked shall be filled with evil.
A wise person fears, and shuns evil, but the fool is hotheaded and reckless.
YHWH's eyes are everywhere, keeping watch on the evil and the good.
The heart of the righteous weighs answers, but the mouth of the wicked gushes out evil.
YHWH has made everything for its own end--yes, even the wicked for the day of evil.
One who winks their eyes to plot perversities, one who compresses their lips, is bent on evil.
Whoever rewards evil for good, evil shall not depart from their house.
A king who sits on the throne of judgment scatters away all evil with his eyes.
Don't say, "I will pay back evil." Wait for YHWH, and YHWH will save you.
Wounding blows cleanse away evil, and beatings purge the innermost parts.
The soul of the wicked desires evil; their neighbor finds no mercy in their eyes.
Woe to those who call evil good, and good evil; who put darkness for light, and light for darkness; who put bitter for sweet, and sweet for bitter!
He shall eat butter and honey when he knows to refuse the evil, and choose the good.
For before the child knows to refuse the evil, and choose the good, the land whose two kings you abhor shall be forsaken.
I will punish the world for their evil, and the wicked for their iniquity. I will cause the arrogance of the proud to cease, and will humble the haughtiness of the terrible.
The ways of the scoundrel are evil. He devises wicked devices to destroy the humble with lying words, even when the needy speaks right.

The one who walks righteously, and speaks blamelessly; The one who despises the gain of oppressions, who gestures with their hands, refusing to take a bribe, who stops their ears from hearing of blood, and shuts their eyes from looking at evil--
Blessed is the one who does this, and the child of humanity who holds it fast; who keeps the Sabbath from profaning it, and keeps his hand from doing any evil.
Their feet run to evil, and they make haste to shed innocent blood: their thoughts are thoughts of iniquity; desolation and destruction are in their paths.
Then YHWH said to me, Out of the north evil shall break forth on all the inhabitants of the land.
For my people have committed two acts of evil: they have forsaken me, the spring of living waters, and hewed them out cisterns, broken cisterns, that can hold no water.
Set up a standard toward Tzion: flee for safety, don't stay; for I will bring evil from the north, and a great destruction.
For a voice declares from Dan, and publishes evil from the hills of Efrayim:
They have denied YHWH, and said, It is not YHWH; neither shall evil come on us; neither shall we see sword nor famine:

For YHWH of Armies, who planted you, has pronounced harm against you, because of the evil of the house of Israel and of the house of Yehudah, which they have worked for themselves in provoking me to anger by offering incense to Baal.
YHWH said, Most certainly I will strengthen you for good; most certainly I will cause the enemy to make supplication to you in the time of evil and in the time of affliction.
Don't be a terror to me: you are my refuge in the day of evil.
Let them be disappointed who persecute me, but let not me be disappointed; let them be dismayed, but don't let me be dismayed; bring on them the day of evil, and destroy them with double destruction.
if that nation, concerning which I have spoken, turn from their evil, I will relent from the evil that I thought to do to them.
Shall evil be recompensed for good? for they have dug a pit for my soul. Remember how I stood before you to speak good for them, to turn away your wrath from them.
Whether it be good, or whether it be evil, we will obey the voice of YHWH our God, to whom we send you; that it may be well with us, when we obey the voice of YHWH our God.

Thus says YHWH of Armies, the God of Israel: You have seen all the evil that I have brought on Yerushalayim, and on all the cities of Yehudah; and behold, this day they are a desolation, and no one dwells therein,
Therefore thus says YHWH of Armies, the God of Israel: Behold, I will set my face against you for evil, even to cut off all Yehudah.

But we will certainly perform every word that is gone forth out of our mouth, to burn incense to the queen of the sky, and to pour out drink offerings to her, as we have done, we and our fathers, our kings and our princes, in the cities of Yehudah, and in the streets of Yerushalayim; for then had we plenty of food, and were well, and saw no evil.
I will render to Bavel and to all the inhabitants of Chaldea all their evil that they have done in Tzion in your sight, says YHWH.

It happened in the seven and thirtieth year of the captivity of Jehoiachin king of Yehudah, in the twelfth month, in the five and twentieth day of the month, that Evilmerodach king of Bavel, in the [first] year of his reign, lifted up the head of Jehoiachin king of Yehudah, and brought him forth out of prison;
They shall know that I am YHWH: I have not said in vain that I would do this evil to them.

Thus says YHWH God: Smite with your hand, and stamp with your foot, and say, Alas! because of all the evil abominations of the house of Israel; for they shall fall by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence.
Thus says YHWH God: It shall happen in that day, that things shall come into your mind, and you shall devise an evil plan:
Seek good, and not evil, that you may live; and so YHWH, the God of Armies, will be with you, as you say.
Hate evil, love good, and establish justice in the courts. It may be that YHWH, the God of Armies, will be gracious to the remnant of Yosef."
Then they will cry to YHWH, but YHWH will not answer them. Yes, YHWH will hide YHWH’s face from them at that time, because their deeds were evil."
Their hands are on that which is evil to do it diligently. The ruler and judge ask for a bribe; and the powerful man dictates the broken desire of his soul. Thus they conspire together.

You who have purer eyes than to see evil, and who cannot look on perversity, why do you tolerate those who deal treacherously, and keep silent when the wicked swallows up the one who is more righteous than they,
Woe to the one who gets dishonest gain for their house, that they may set their nest on high, that they may be delivered from the hand of evil!
YHWH has taken away your judgments. YHWH has thrown out your enemy. The King of Israel, YHWH, is in the midst of you. You will not be afraid of evil any more.

Don't you be like your fathers, to whom the former prophets proclaimed, saying: Thus says YHWH of Armies, 'Return now from your wrong ways, and from your evil doings;' but they did not hear, nor listen to me, says YHWH.

When you offer the blind for sacrifice, isn't that evil? And when you offer the lame and sick, isn't that evil? Present it now to your governor! Will he be pleased with you? Or will he accept your person?" says YHWH of Armies.

You have wearied YHWH with your words. Yet you say, 'How have we wearied YHWH?' In that you say, 'Everyone who does evil is good in the sight of YHWH, and they delights in them;' or 'Where is the God of justice?'
